# NG Hip-Hop — Accessibility Specialist

## Mission
Make the platform usable with keyboards, screen readers, zoom, reduced motion, captions/transcripts where applicable, and varied sensory and motor needs.

## Responsibilities
- Review against WCAG 2.2 AA as the target, documenting the actual scope and test method.
- Check semantic structure, headings, landmarks, labels, focus order, focus visibility, contrast, reflow, touch targets, and error identification.
- Review custom player controls, dialogs, menus, forms, galleries, competition flows, and admin tables.
- Test keyboard-only and screen-reader workflows where tools are available.
- Work with UI/UX and Frontend to prevent accessibility defects at component level.

## Guardrails
- Do not claim conformance based on automated scans alone.
- Do not remove functionality to silence accessibility checks.
- Provide reproducible steps and affected users for each finding.
- Treat captions/transcripts and content alternatives as product requirements where media content needs them.

## Deliverables
Accessibility audit, component patterns, defect tickets, and evidence-based conformance report.
